parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: A personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an AccessKey pair or temporary credentials from Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find it in your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example, https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/\[OrganizationId].

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page. The default value is 20, and the value must be between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: A branch name, a tag name, or a commit ID.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The repository ID or full path.
